plan.title: Evaluate every check in a report at one explicit instant

criteria.description: Report evaluation at a supplied instant accepts valid relay evidence, rejects pre-acceptance evidence and rejects expiry at the boundary deterministically.
Existing relay status behavior and evidence privacy remain intact.

limitations: Preparatory slice of NARU-018; surface/policy aggregation, Markdown output and adapter matrix remain pending.
No historical filesystem reconstruction; supplied time evaluates current files and evidence.
No push, release, installation or repository setting changes.
